facts.summary: Phase 2a missed sweat chloride endpoint; add-on not advancing · Phase 2 · SION-719 added to Trikafta in cystic fibrosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: SION-719 Phase 2a proof-of-concept trial did not achieve key activity endpoint of sweat chloride reduction when added to standard of care; Company is not advancing SION-719 as an add-on to standard of care
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The PreciSION CF trial did not meet its key activity endpoint, with a -1.0 mmol/L mean placebo-adjusted sweat chloride change (p=0.7).
evidence.safety: SION-719 was generally well tolerated when added to Trikafta for 14 days with most treatment emergent adverse events mild to moderate, no serious adverse events
evidence.program_discontinued: Based on these results, Sionna does not plan to advance SION-719 as an add-on to standard of care.
